# Flutter Intl Generated Files

This directory contains automatically generated localization files created by the Flutter Intl system.

## Important Notes:

- **DO NOT MODIFY** any files in this directory manually
- Changes made here will be overwritten on the next generation

## Generated Files:
- `intl/messages_*.dart` - Internal message formatting files

## Workflow:

1. Add/edit strings in the ARB files located in `../l10n/` directory
3. Access translations in code via `context.loc.stringKey`

For more information on Flutter localization, see:
https://docs.flutter.dev/development/accessibility-and-localization/internationalization
